responsibility: Defines the selective scheduler’s internal representation: virtual instructions, expressions, history records, instruction and boundary lists, fences, availability-set operations, basic-block data accessors, pool APIs, CFG helpers, and transformation hooks. It is the main private abstraction header for selective scheduling, capturing the scheduler-specific IR and services used across sel-sched.cc, sel-sched-ir.cc, and the dump code.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the private selective-scheduling IR—virtual instructions, expressions, lists, fences, sets, and CFG/helper APIs shared across the subsystem. The same-stem source gcc/sel-sched-ir.cc implements those data structures, pools, and region/CFG support routines.
